Cc: camila_reyes@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: marketplace connector discovery (thanks!)

Hi Priyom / Camila —

Thanks again for the 30-minute intro today — really useful to understand Redwood's Dedicated and Private deployment options. As promised, attaching a short doc with our initial connector requirements and the Marketplace vendor checklist our procurement team will use.

High-level takeaways from our side:
- Primary use: list CloudJunction connectors on Redwood Marketplace so our shared customers can deploy quickly.
- Technical constraints: single-tenant VPC support, image signing for connector artifacts, and SAML-based SSO for admin UI.
- Timeline: procurement + security review in July, aim for a technical deep-dive in late July.

Can we lock a 60-minute technical slot w/ someone from the infra/runtime team to validate kernel/quantization compatibility and discuss packaging constraints? Marta (cc'd on follow-up) will own procurement questions.

Attachments: CloudJunction-RI-requirements-v1.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Ethan
Senior Partnerships, CloudJunction
